    Free Up to 2000 Words Assignment Help in the UK: Limited-Time Offer for 2026

    A limited-time offer: up to 2000 words of assignment help free for eligible business, finance, management, tourism, marketing and accounting assessments.

    free assignment help UK2000 words freelimited offerbusinessfinance

    Quick Answer

    How does the free 2000 words offer work?

    For a limited time, Academia Helper completes up to 2000 words of your assignment free for business, finance, management, tourism, marketing and accounting assessments. If your assignment is 2000 words or under, the whole task is free. If it is longer, the first 2000 words are free and you only pay for the remaining words at a written, agreed quote.

    How the Free 2000 Words Offer Works

    The concept is simple and transparent. Send your assignment brief, and we confirm in writing before any work starts exactly which words are free and which words, if any, are paid. There are only two cases, and both are confirmed up front so there are no surprises later.

    If your total word count is 2000 words or fewer, you pay nothing for the writing. A 1500-word marketing essay, a 1200-word tourism report or a 2000-word accounting assignment is completed free in full, with the same quality guarantees as paid work: human-written content, under 10% similarity, 0% AI content, correct referencing and unlimited revisions.

    If your assignment is longer than 2000 words, the first 2000 words are still completely free. You only pay for the words above 2000. A 2500-word management report means 2000 words free and a quote for 500 words. A 3000-word finance dissertation chapter means 2000 words free and a quote for 1000 words. The paid remainder is quoted in writing before work begins, so you decide with full information.

    Your word countWhat is freeWhat you pay
    1500 wordsAll 1500 wordsNothing
    2000 wordsAll 2000 wordsNothing
    2500 wordsFirst 2000 words500 words at agreed quote
    3000 wordsFirst 2000 words1000 words at agreed quote

    Which Assessments Qualify

    This offer covers written assessments in six subject areas: finance, business, management, tourism, marketing and accounting. These are the disciplines where our MA and PhD-qualified writers have the deepest bench, which is why we can extend this offer there with full quality.

    Eligible task types include essays, reports, case studies, coursework assignments, reflective pieces and literature reviews. Whether it is a business strategy essay, a financial ratio analysis, a marketing plan, an HRM-linked management report, a tourism development report or an accounting theory assignment, the same rule applies: the first 2000 words are free.

    The offer suits UK undergraduate and Masters-level work, and the same subjects at other levels are considered case by case. Timed exams, live tests and anything requiring your university login are excluded. If you are unsure whether your task fits, send the brief and ask. We confirm eligibility in writing before anything starts, as explained in our guide to choosing assignment help in the UK.

    What You Get in the Free Words

    Free does not mean a lighter service. The free 2000 words carry the same guarantees as our paid work. Every paper is written by a human subject expert, checked for originality with under 10% similarity, delivered with 0% AI content and matched to your marking rubric, word count allocation and referencing style, whether Harvard, APA or another system.

    You also get unlimited revisions on the delivered work until it matches the brief you sent. If your lecturer notes require a specific framework, for example a SWOT analysis in a business report or ratio calculations in a finance assignment, that is built into the free words. Before ordering, it helps to read your criteria with our guide on reading a university marking rubric so you can send exactly what the expert needs.

    How to Claim in 4 Steps

    Claiming the offer takes four short steps. First, send your assignment question, marking rubric, word count, deadline and referencing style through the order form, WhatsApp or email. A complete brief lets us confirm the free-versus-paid split accurately, so use the pre-assignment checklist before sending.

    Second, we reply in writing with the confirmed split: fully free, or 2000 words free plus a fixed quote for the remainder. Third, the subject expert completes your work to the agreed scope and deadline. Fourth, you review the delivery and request unlimited revisions until it matches your brief. Nothing is charged for the free words at any stage.

    What Happens Above 2000 Words

    Longer assignments are common at Masters level, so here is exactly how the paid remainder works. After reviewing your brief, we quote a fixed price for only the words above 2000, based on word count, level, subject complexity and deadline. Technical work such as data analysis or financial modelling is priced on the same transparent basis described in our UK pricing guide.

    The quote is fixed before work starts and already includes revisions on the whole delivery. If you prefer, you can also narrow the scope to fit 2000 words, for example by requesting one chapter or one section free, and handling the rest yourself with our feedback. Either way, the first 2000 words stay free.

    Why This Is a Limited-Time Offer

    Two thousand free words per assessment is a significant commitment of expert time, so this offer runs on limited weekly slots and can close without notice once capacity fills. Each assessment is handled by a qualified subject writer rather than a template, which caps how many free assessments we can take on each week.

    The practical advice is simple: if you have an eligible assessment with a real deadline, send the brief now while slots remain. Early requests also get better turnaround, because the expert has more time to match your rubric carefully instead of rushing near the deadline.

    A Note on Academic Integrity

    Use this support responsibly and within your university rules. The safest use of any writing assistance is as a learning aid: study the structure, analysis and referencing, then produce and submit your own final work. Commercial contract-cheating services aimed at English institutions fall under the Skills and Post-16 Education Act 2022, so never submit work produced by someone else as if you wrote it yourself. Check your module handbook and ask your tutor when in doubt.

    Key Takeaways

    • Up to 2000 words of assignment help free on eligible business, finance, management, tourism, marketing and accounting assessments.
    • 2000 words or under: the full assignment is free. Over 2000 words: the first 2000 are free, remainder at a fixed written quote.
    • Same guarantees on free words: human-written, under 10% similarity, 0% AI, rubric-matched, unlimited revisions.
    • Send your brief, rubric, word count and deadline now: weekly slots are limited.

    Frequently Asked Questions

    Is it really free, or is there a catch?
    The first 2000 words are genuinely free with no payment required for that portion. If your work exceeds 2000 words, only the remainder is quoted, in writing, before work starts.
    What if my assignment is exactly 2000 words?
    Then the entire assignment is free, including revisions and referencing.
    Which subjects are covered?
    Finance, business, management, tourism, marketing and accounting assessments, including essays, reports, case studies and coursework.
    How fast can you deliver my free words?
    Share your exact deadline and timezone. Urgent deadlines are considered, and on-time delivery is guaranteed for every accepted order.
    Is the free work original?
    Yes. Human-written, checked for originality under 10% similarity, 0% AI content, with unlimited revisions until it matches your brief.
    My dissertation chapter is 3500 words. How does that work?
    The first 2000 words are free and you receive a fixed quote for the remaining 1500 words before anything begins.
